name: okf-wiki-handoff
description: Keeps a per-session OKF handoff note current and brings it back after context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a handoff note that survives compaction.
interface.longDescription: Prompts the agent to keep a per-session OKF handoff note current, reminds it as work accumulates, and shows the note again with recallable archived transcript segments after the context is compacted.
